name: Inami Yuuki
source:
Unlike Tooru, he passed the university entrance exam and is one year younger than Tooru.

He is a beautiful boy with a neutral disposition. Because of his gentle nature, he does not have many friends, but he trusts Tooru as an important friend.

He is proud of his beautiful mother and is aware that he has a serious mother complex.

One day, he accidentally discovers his mother's lecherous nature, and his feelings for his mother lead him into a dark place in his heart and out of control.

[From [url=http://www.cattleyasoft.com/cat11/character.html]official site[/url]]
